2.192.7
NumericIndicator.ToolTip
Applies to RDL 2008/01, RDL 2010/01, and RDL 2016/01
The NumericIndicator.ToolTip element is ignored. If it is present, however, its data type is
validated, and the value MUST be a String ([XMLSCHEMA2/2] section 3.2.1) or an expression that
evaluates to a String.
The following is the parent element of the NumericIndicator.ToolTip element.
Parent elements
NumericIndicator
The following is the XML Schema definition of the NumericIndicator.ToolTip element.
 <xsd:element name="ToolTip" type="xsd:string" minOccurs="0" />
